parameters.description: Only this kind of transaction, e.g. Payment. Leave empty for every kind.
parameters.name: transaction_type

parameters.description: List the oldest transactions first instead of the newest.
parameters.name: oldest_first

parameters.description: How many transactions to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

has_more.description: True when there are more than came back. Raise 'Number of results' to see more.

account.description: The address that sent (signed) the transaction.

amount.description: The amount it names: what a payment sends, an escrow or channel holds, a check allows or an NFT offer asks.

currency.description: 'XRP', a token's code such as 'USD' or 'RLUSD', 'MPT' for a multi-purpose token, or the 40-character hex code of a token whose code is not text (such as an AMM's LP token).

drops.description: For XRP, the exact amount in drops (1 XRP is 1,000,000 drops). Empty for tokens.

issuer.description: The address that issues the token. Empty for XRP and MPTs.

mpt_issuance_id.description: For a multi-purpose token, its issuance id. Empty otherwise.

value.description: How much, in XRP for XRP and in the token's own units otherwise.

date.description: When that ledger closed, ISO 8601 in UTC.

delivered_amount.description: For a payment that succeeded, what actually arrived. Use this rather than the amount: a partial payment can deliver less.

currency.description: 'XRP', a token's code such as 'USD' or 'RLUSD', 'MPT' for a multi-purpose token, or the 40-character hex code of a token whose code is not text (such as an AMM's LP token).

drops.description: For XRP, the exact amount in drops (1 XRP is 1,000,000 drops). Empty for tokens.

issuer.description: The address that issues the token. Empty for XRP and MPTs.

mpt_issuance_id.description: For a multi-purpose token, its issuance id. Empty otherwise.

value.description: How much, in XRP for XRP and in the token's own units otherwise.

destination.description: The address it was sent to, for payments, checks and escrows.

destination_tag.description: The destination tag: the number an exchange or service uses to tell its customers apart.

direction.description: 'sent' when the account sent it, 'received' when it was sent to the account, else 'other' (e.g. an offer of the account's that someone else's transaction filled).

ledger_index.description: The ledger it was validated in.

memos.description: The text of each memo attached, decoded (hex when not text).

result.description: The result code: 'tesSUCCESS' when it succeeded, else a code such as 'tecPATH_DRY'.

sequence.description: The sender's sequence number it used.

source_tag.description: The source tag the sender set, if any.

succeeded.description: True when the result is tesSUCCESS.

summary.description: What it did, in a sentence, e.g. 'rA... paid 25 XRP to rB...'.

type.description: The kind of transaction, e.g. 'Payment', 'OfferCreate' or 'TrustSet'.

list_trust_lines.description: List the tokens an account holds (or, for a token issuer, who holds its tokens): each trust line's token, counterparty, balance and limit, and its freeze and rippling settings.
list_trust_lines.name: list_trust_lines

parameters.description: The account's address. It starts with r.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Only the line with this account, e.g. one token's issuer. Leave empty for every line.
parameters.name: counterparty

parameters.description: How many trust lines to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

count.description: How many trust lines came back.

has_more.description: True when there are more than came back. Raise 'Number of results' to see more.

ledger_index.description: The validated ledger the answer was read from.

authorized.description: True when the account has authorized the counterparty to hold its token.

balance.description: How much of the token the account holds (negative when it owes it, as an issuer does).

counterparty.description: The other account on the line: usually the token's issuer.

counterparty_authorized.description: True when the issuer has authorized the account to hold the token.

counterparty_frozen.description: True when the counterparty froze this line.

counterparty_limit.description: The most the counterparty is willing to hold from the account.

counterparty_no_ripple.description: True when the counterparty blocks rippling on this line.

currency.description: The token's code, e.g. 'USD'.

frozen.description: True when the account froze this line.

limit.description: The most of the token the account is willing to hold.

no_ripple.description: True when the account blocks rippling (balances passing through it) on this line.

description: Read the XRP Ledger through its public servers: account balances and settings, transactions and ledgers, tokens and trust lines, NFTs and their offers, order books, AMM pools, price oracles and network fees, and start workflows when an account transacts or is paid. No account or API key required.

xrp_ledger_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs for every validated transaction that touches an account: ones it sends, ones sent to it, and others that change it. Optionally only one kind of transaction.

parameters.description: The XRP Ledger address to watch. It starts with r.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Only this kind of transaction, e.g. Payment or OfferCreate. Leave blank for every kind.
parameters.name: transaction_type

xrp_ledger_payment_received_trigger.description: Runs when a payment to an account succeeds, with the amount actually delivered. Optionally only one currency or one destination tag.

parameters.description: The XRP Ledger address to watch. It starts with r.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Only payments in this currency: XRP, a token code such as RLUSD, or CODE:ISSUER for one issuer's token. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Only payments carrying this destination tag, the number an exchange or service gives each customer. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: destination_tag
